edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, CNBC reported “at a 21 billion euro valuation.”; on 2026-09-08, France 24 reported “French startup Mistral AI is now valued at €21 billion”.
On 2026-10-06, CNBC reported “at a 21 billion euro valuation.”; on 2026-09-08, France 24 reported “valuing the French AI firm at over 21 billion euros.”.

On 2026-10-06, Deutsche Welle reported “Last month, Mistral raised €3 billion euros ($3.4 billion), Europe's biggest technology fundraising.”; on 2026-09-08, CNBC reported “Mistral on Tuesday said it raised 3 billion euros ($3.5 billion) in fresh funding led by memory chip giant Samsung, as the French startup looks to position itself as a European alternative to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic.”.
